$comment: Vendored, not owned here. The epistemic_type value set is defined ONCE, on the record header's `epistemic_type` field. This file is a literal, lower-case transcription of that closed set (the same values as agent-action-capsule's schemas/vendor/epistemic-types.json), so capsule-engine's EPISTEMIC_TYPE_VALUES parity test reads a machine-readable copy, never a second hand-typed enum. A change to the owning set is a drift that must be re-vendored here, not silently re-derived.
